REST.top: Come unto me, all ye that labour
REST.bottom: and are heavy laden, and I will give you rest.

HOPE.bottom: for I shall yet praise him...

LOVE.top: This is my commandment, That ye
LOVE.bottom: love one another, as I have loved you.

TRUST.top: Commit thy way unto the LORD;
TRUST.bottom: trust also in him; and he shall bring it to pass.

PRAY.top: And he said unto them, When ye pray, say,
PRAY.bottom: Our Father which art in heaven, Hallowed be thy name.

BELIEVE.top: Let not your heart be troubled.
BELIEVE.bottom: Believe in God, believe also in me.

FORGIVE.top: For if ye forgive men their trespasses,
FORGIVE.bottom: your heavenly Father will also forgive you.

GIVE.top: Give, and it shall be given unto you; good measure,
GIVE.bottom: pressed down, and shaken together, and running over...

SEEK.top: But seek ye first the kingdom of God, and his righteousness;
SEEK.bottom: and all these things shall be added unto you.

ASK.top: ...how much more shall your heavenly Father
ASK.bottom: give the Holy Spirit to them that ask Him?

KNOCK.top: Ask, and it will be given to you; seek and ye shall find;
KNOCK.bottom: knock and it shall be opened unto you.

FOLLOW.top: If any man will come after me, let him deny himself,
FOLLOW.bottom: and take up his cross daily, and follow me.

LISTEN.top: But whoever listens to me will dwell safely,
LISTEN.bottom: And will be secure, without fear of evil.

REMEMBER.top: This is my body which is given for you:
REMEMBER.bottom: this do in remembrance of me.

CHOOSE.top: I have set before you life and death,
CHOOSE.bottom: blessing and cursing: therefore choose life...

HONOR.bottom: which is the first commandment with a promise.

GROW.top: But grow in grace, and in the knowledge
GROW.bottom: of our Lord and Saviour Jesus Christ.

GATHER.top: For where two or three are gathered
GATHER.bottom: in my name, there I am in the midst of them.

ACCEPT.top: Therefore, accept one another, just as Christ
ACCEPT.bottom: also accepted us, for the glory of God.

BREATHE.top: Come from the four winds, O breath,
BREATHE.bottom: and breathe upon these slain, that they may live.

ENJOY.top: And also that every man should eat and drink, and
ENJOY.bottom: enjoy the good of all his labour, it is the gift of God.

LIVE.top: I shall not die, but live,
LIVE.bottom: And declare the works of the LORD.

SING.top: Sing unto Him a new song;
SING.bottom: Play skilfully with a loud noise.

LAUGH.top: A time to weep, and a time to laugh;
LAUGH.bottom: a time to mourn, and a time to dance;

REST.top: Venid a mí todos los que estáis trabajados
REST.bottom: y cargados, y yo os haré descansar.

LOVE.top: Este es mi mandamiento: Que os améis
LOVE.bottom: unos a otros, como yo os he amado.

TRUST.bottom: y confía en él; y él hará.

PRAY.bottom: que estás en los cielos, santificado sea tu nombre.

BELIEVE.bottom: creéis en Dios, creed también en mí.

FORGIVE.top: Porque si perdonáis a los hombres sus ofensas,
FORGIVE.bottom: os perdonará también a vosotros vuestro Padre celestial.

GIVE.bottom: medida buena, apretada, remecida y rebosando...

SEEK.top: Mas buscad primeramente el reino de Dios

ASK.bottom: el Espíritu Santo a los que se lo pidan?

KNOCK.bottom: Porque todo aquel que pide, recibe...

FOLLOW.top: Si alguno quiere venir en pos de mí,
FOLLOW.bottom: niéguese a sí mismo, tome su cruz cada día, y sígame.

LISTEN.top: Mas el que me oyere, habitará confiadamente
LISTEN.bottom: y vivirá tranquilo, sin temor del mal.

REMEMBER.top: Esto es mi cuerpo, que por vosotros es dado;
REMEMBER.bottom: haced esto en memoria de mí.

CHOOSE.top: Os he puesto delante la vida y la muerte...

HONOR.top: Honra a tu padre y a tu madre,
HONOR.bottom: que es el primer mandamiento con promesa.

GROW.top: Creced en la gracia y el conocimiento
GROW.bottom: de nuestro Señor y Salvador Jesucristo.

GATHER.top: Donde están dos o tres congregados en mi nombre,
GATHER.bottom: allí estoy yo en medio de ellos.

ACCEPT.top: Recibíos los unos a los otros,
ACCEPT.bottom: como también Cristo nos recibió, para gloria de Dios.

BREATHE.top: Espíritu, ven de los cuatro vientos,
BREATHE.bottom: y sopla sobre estos muertos, y vivirán.

ENJOY.top: Que todo hombre coma y beba, y goce el bien
ENJOY.bottom: de toda su labor, es don de Dios.

LIVE.bottom: y contaré las obras de JAH.

SING.bottom: cantad a Jehová, toda la tierra.

LAUGH.top: Tiempo de llorar, y tiempo de reír;
LAUGH.bottom: tiempo de endechar, y tiempo de bailar.
